raw.details:
Code Your Journey. Create the Future.

Organized by AlgoXilla:

Welcome to CodeOdyssey '26, an exciting hackathon where innovation meets technology. Bring your ideas to life, solve real-world problems, collaborate with talented developers, and showcase your technical skills.

Whether you're passionate about AI/ML, Web Development, App Development, Blockchain, or other emerging technologies, this is your opportunity to build something innovative and gain practical experience.

Domains:

  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
  • Web and App Development
  • Blockchain and Web3
  • FinTech and EdTech
  • Cybersecurity
  • Healthcare and Social Impact
  • Open Innovation

Eligibility and Team Formation:

  • Open to college students, developers, and technology enthusiasts.
  • Individual and team participation will be permitted according to the official registration options.
  • All participants must provide accurate registration details.

Registration Fee:

  • ₹100 per participant.
  • Registration is confirmed after successful payment.
  • Refunds will be governed by the official event policy and applicable law.

Hackathon Process:

  • Register through the official registration platform.
  • Select a permitted problem statement or develop an original idea.
  • Build your project within the announced timeline.
  • Submit your project with the required source code, description, and demo.
  • Projects will be evaluated by the judging panel.
  • Winners will be announced through official communication channels.

Project Submission

Participants may be required to submit:

  • Project description and problem statement.
  • GitHub repository or source code link.
  • Deployment link, if applicable.
  • Demo video or presentation.
  • Technologies used and explanation of the solution.

Judging Criteria:

Projects will be evaluated on innovation, technical implementation, problem-solving, user experience, practical impact, and presentation.

Rules and Guidelines:

  • Plagiarism, fraudulent submissions, and misrepresentation are prohibited.
  • Participants must follow the official submission deadlines.
  • Third-party libraries and AI tools may be used according to the event guidelines.
  • Participants must maintain professional conduct throughout the event.
  • Incomplete or late submissions may be disqualified according to the official rules.
  • The organizers' decisions will follow the published evaluation policy.

Prizes and Certificates:

Cash prizes and certificates will be awarded according to the official prize announcement. Final prize amounts and eligibility details will be communicated through the official channels.

Mandatory WhatsApp Group:

Joining the official WhatsApp group is mandatory for every registered participant.

All important announcements, event instructions, deadlines, submission updates, and other essential information will be shared through the group's communication channels.

If you do not join the WhatsApp group, you may miss important updates. AlgoXilla cannot guarantee individual delivery of announcements to participants who have not joined the group.

Join the official WhatsApp group here:

https://chat.whatsapp.com/GbnZnwnVbY92QrGJUvb7GR

Important Note:

Participants are responsible for joining the WhatsApp group, checking announcements regularly, and completing their submissions on time. Please follow the official registration page and organizer communications for confirmed dates, schedules, team-size rules, and other event-specific details.

Think. Code. Innovate. Conquer.
